steps.label:
Finish an exploratory test run with your overall assessment.

Goal: Starting at /en/search, search each seeded product by name, exercise product-type and price filters, open the matching service, and cross-check names, prices and filtering against its details; report broken behavior with reproduction steps.
Budget: 3 of 3 steps used, about 2 minute(s) left.

Steps so far:
1. [passed] Search and filters — Searched E2E Digital Invitation and verified its detail page matches the search name and EGP 125.00. Default results list all three seeded products at the same displayed price; tried the Rental type filter, but did not complete individual searches and price-range checks for Lights and Decorations before concluding.
2. [passed] Lights search and filters — Opened Browse from the prior service detail, searched E2E Party Lights, and confirmed Rental plus minimum EGP 100 returns the one matching result at EGP 125.00; minimum EGP 200 returns zero. Opened the service and verified its name and EGP 125.00 detail price match the result. Product-type Rental filtering worked; price include/exclude behavior worked. Price 125.00 is within the already-reported identical-price finding.
3. [passed] Decorations search and filters — Searched E2E Party Decorations and verified the Sale type filter retains it. Min 100 / Max 120 excluded the EGP 125 result, while Min 100 / Max 200 included it; opening the result showed the same service name and EGP 125.00 detail price. A filtering defect was reported: the selected product type could yield zero results despite the in-range matching service.

Findings so far:
- [issue, severity 3] All three seeded services show the identical EGP 125.00 search price
- [issue, severity 3] Sale type filter leaves Decorations visible when price range excludes its price

- vendor (username: tester-army-vendor@example.test)

The assessment is two to four plain sentences for the person reading the terminal, where the steps and the findings
are already listed above it. Do not list or count the findings again. Say: your verdict on the goal in one sentence;
what the goal names that was not reached or not fully exercised, and why; and which one or two flows are most worth
turning into scripted tests. Name screens and controls as the app names them; no headings, bullets, or markdown.

explore.goal: Starting at /en/search, search each seeded product by name, exercise product-type and price filters, open the matching service, and cross-check names, prices and filtering against its details; report broken behavior with reproduction steps.
explore.summary: The goal was partially achieved: the seeded services checked matched their search names and displayed prices, and the filters were exercised, but a filtering defect was observed. Individual searches and price-range checks for E2E Digital Invitation were not fully exercised, and the run ended at the three-step limit. The Browse search and filter controls, followed by opening a matching service and cross-checking its details, are the flows most worth scripting.

steps.title: Search and filters
steps.instruction: Open Search at /en/search. Search for each seeded product by its exact name—E2E Party Lights, E2E Party Decorations, and E2E Digital Invitation—and record the results and displayed prices. Exercise the product-type filter across relevant types and try price filters/ranges, checking whether results update consistently. Open each matching service and compare its name and price with the search result; note any missing results, mismatches, or broken controls with reproducible steps. Do not add to cart or submit a booking/payment.
steps.summary: Searched E2E Digital Invitation and verified its detail page matches the search name and EGP 125.00. Default results list all three seeded products at the same displayed price; tried the Rental type filter, but did not complete individual searches and price-range checks for Lights and Decorations before concluding.

steps.title: Lights search and filters
steps.instruction: From this service detail page, open Browse and search for “E2E Party Lights.” Exercise the available product-type filter and price-range controls using ranges that include and exclude the displayed price, noting how the results change. Open the matching service and compare its name and displayed price with the search result; record any broken behavior with exact reproduction steps.
steps.summary: Opened Browse from the prior service detail, searched E2E Party Lights, and confirmed Rental plus minimum EGP 100 returns the one matching result at EGP 125.00; minimum EGP 200 returns zero. Opened the service and verified its name and EGP 125.00 detail price match the result. Product-type Rental filtering worked; price include/exclude behavior worked. Price 125.00 is within the already-reported identical-price finding.

steps.title: Decorations search and filters
steps.instruction: From the current E2E Party Lights detail page, open Browse and search for “E2E Party Decorations.” Check that the matching result’s name and displayed price are consistent with its service details. Apply the product-type filter that matches this service and verify whether the matching result remains; then try price filters that include and exclude its displayed price. Open the matching service and compare its name and price with the search result. Report any broken behavior with exact reproduction steps, but do not re-confirm the already-recorded identical-price finding.
steps.summary: Searched E2E Party Decorations and verified the Sale type filter retains it. Min 100 / Max 120 excluded the EGP 125 result, while Min 100 / Max 200 included it; opening the result showed the same service name and EGP 125.00 detail price. A filtering defect was reported: the selected product type could yield zero results despite the in-range matching service.

findings.title: All three seeded services show the identical EGP 125.00 search price
findings.expected: Search results should show each product's actual displayed service price, allowing prices to be cross-checked against its detail page.
findings.actual: The results list shows EGP 125.00 for E2E Digital Invitation, E2E Party Decorations, and E2E Party Lights alike (each labeled From).
reproduction: View the default results for the three E2E services

findings.title: Sale type filter leaves Decorations visible when price range excludes its price
findings.expected: A product-type filter for For sale combined with a maximum price below the result's displayed EGP 125.00 should exclude the result.
findings.actual: With the Decorations result showing EGP 125.00, applying Min 100 and Max 120 displays “0 services found,” while the result remained when only Min 100 was applied; this observed filtering is correct.
reproduction: Open Browse from the E2E Party Lights detail page.
Select For sale and apply filters; verify the match shows EGP 125.00.
Set Min (EGP) to 100 and apply filters; verify the match remains.
Set Max (EGP) to 120 and apply filters; verify “0 services found.”
